subject.title: Race condition (missing tool result / synthetic errors) still reproducible on 2026.6.11 AND 2026.7.1-beta.2 — supersedes closed #31664/#6682/#15008/#13286

question: Should maintainers require redacted long-running Feishu or comparable production-runner proof before treating https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97646 or a successor as the fix for this issue?
rationale: The source boundary and focused fix candidate line up with the report, but the issue reports a long-session production race and the active PR remains explicitly proof-gated.

options.title: Require production-path proof
options.body: Ask for redacted Feishu, channel, or runner logs showing real tool results persist without synthetic missing-result entries before landing the fix candidate.

options.title: Accept focused source proof
options.body: Maintainers can choose to land based on source inspection and focused tests, while owning the remaining production-path uncertainty.

options.title: Audit release provenance first
options.body: A release owner can first answer the v2026.6.11 and beta gitHead/provenance question before deciding whether to backport or land the candidate fix.

recommendation.title: Require production-path proof
recommendation.body: Ask for redacted Feishu, channel, or runner logs showing real tool results persist without synthetic missing-result entries before landing the fix candidate.

likelyOwner.reason: The session guard and transcript repair history make this the strongest routing candidate for proof sufficiency and fix-boundary decisions.
